handoff.conclusion: Questie 95349 says take the skycutter from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker. Her only spawn is zone 215 at 33.37, 22.57 (uiMap 1412). The quest text does not name Skywatcher Plateau and does not say to ride to Thunder Bluff. 95350, from that same NPC, sends the player to Thrall in Orgrimmar. Joining the existing Mulgore 1-12 route is not what these quests say.
